correctness.rationale: For each N>=8 the restricted support is uniquely determined by a five-part integer composition (a,u,b,v,c) with occupied parts >=2 and gaps >=1, quotienting the normalized masks by reversal. A unit-cell indicator has Fourier transform a common sinc multiplier times P_x(exp(-2 pi i xi)); equality of continuous magnitudes is equivalent to equality of all aperiodic integer autocorrelations, with the maximal nonzero lag recovering N. Independently enumerated all compositions N=8..19, computed correlations by integer bit shifts, and independently checked the provided CHECK.py source: reversal-class counts 1,3,9,19,38,66,110,170,255,365,511,693 and distinct-signature counts identical until N=18, then 692 at N=19. Exactly one size-two fiber is represented by (2,1,10,3,3) and (2,3,5,1,8), sharing the 19-entry correlation (15,12,10,9,9,9,9,8,7,6,5,5,4,3,2,2,2,2,1). Independently checked the polynomial zero-flip Q=(1+z+z^2+z^6+z^7), A=(1+z^8+z^11), B=z^11 A(z^-1)=(1+z^3+z^11); QA,QB have disjoint binary coefficient supports and identical Laurent products. Full finite enumeration proves the first collision only in this restricted class, not unrestricted intervals.
